temporal_state_chain.observed: Ethan notices that Gary has been working excessively long hours at the hospital, often skipping meals and sacrificing sleep. When Ethan invites Gary to a weekend retreat, Gary declines because he has too much to do at the hospital.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Ethan knows Gary as a dedicated friend and doctor, but has not yet fully concluded that Gary's work habits are harmful or unsustainable.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes. Ethan's concern is confirmed and strengthened: Gary is severely overworked, and his hospital obligations are preventing him from accepting help.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Gary is dangerously overworked and needs rest and support, but he currently prioritizes his hospital duties and is unwilling or unable to step away.
temporal_state_chain.emotion: Concerned, worried, sympathetic, and somewhat disappointed by Gary's refusal.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To intervene in Gary's health situation and find another way to help or persuade him to take a break.

temporal_state_chain.observed: During the retreat, Ethan observes Gary's restless behavior and avoidance of discussions about work. When Ethan confronts him, Gary says it is complicated and that he did not want to burden Ethan.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Ethan believes Gary's overwork is mainly caused by hospital obligations, though he is puzzled by Gary's reluctance and unease.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes. Ethan begins to suspect that Gary's overwork is not only professional but also involves deeper personal or complicated issues that Gary is hiding.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Gary has significant problems beyond ordinary hospital workload and is reluctant to share them, possibly because he does not want to burden Ethan.
temporal_state_chain.emotion: Concerned, suspicious, empathetic, and gently hurt, but still nonjudgmental.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To confront Gary gently, encourage him to open up, and reassure him that Ethan is there to help without judging.

temporal_state_chain.observed: After the confrontation, Gary opens up about the pressures of managing a new department and personal challenges he is facing. Gary agrees when Ethan suggests prioritizing tasks and delegating responsibilities.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Ethan believes Gary has deeper personal and professional pressures, but he does not yet know the specifics or whether Gary will accept help.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes. Ethan learns the specific sources of Gary's stress and sees that Gary is willing to accept support and work toward better balance.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Gary's overwork stems from new department pressures and personal challenges, and it can be improved through prioritization, delegation, and support.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To help Gary organize his schedule, prioritize tasks, delegate responsibilities, and find a healthier work-life balance.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Over the following months, Ethan regularly checks in with Gary. Gary reports that things are better, that he is less overwhelmed, and that he even had time for a movie. Ethan sees Gary making efforts to change.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Ethan believes Gary is working toward better balance with support, but still faces challenges and may need continued encouragement.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes. Ethan sees that his support and Gary's efforts are producing real progress, and that Gary is becoming less overwhelmed.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Gary is making steady progress toward a healthier balance and is improving, though continued encouragement and checking in remain helpful.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To continue checking in, offering support, and encouraging Gary's progress.

temporal_state_chain.observed: After a year, Gary has successfully adjusted to a healthier work-life balance. Gary says he feels more in control and thanks Ethan for his support. Ethan sees that Gary can manage on his own.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Ethan believes Gary has improved significantly but may still benefit from occasional support or check-ins.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes. Ethan now believes Gary is capable of maintaining a healthy balance independently and no longer needs active intervention.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Gary is capable of managing his own work-life balance, and Ethan can step back while remaining available if needed.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To step back from active support but let Gary know he is always available if needed.
